name: Medes
overview: The Medes were a significant people in biblical history, known as inhabitants of the region of Media where some Israelites were resettled after the Assyrian captivity (2 Kings 17:6; 18:11). Their territory included important centers such as Achmetha or Ecbatana, where royal records were kept (Ezra 6:2). The Medes formed an essential part of the Medo-Persian Empire, which held considerable power and influence over many provinces, as seen during the reign of King Ahasuerus, whose kingdom extended from India to Ethiopia (Esther 1:1-3). This highlights the Medes' role in God's providential history, especially in relation to His people and the unfolding of His sovereign plans.
